Your Surrey wedding music questions

Can we choose our first dance song?

Tell us the song you have in mind. We’ll check whether your chosen band already plays it or can offer a special request, including any extra fee or notice needed.

Can you help us choose a band for our Surrey venue?

Of course. Send us the venue, date, approximate guest numbers and your favourite music. We’ll help you find a band and lineup that suit your celebration.

How much does a wedding band cost?

The price depends on your chosen band, lineup, date, venue and any extras. Send us your plans for a tailored quote, or ask us to suggest options within your budget.
